name: Horizon Europe — Cluster 5
description: The flagship EU research grant for climate, energy and mobility. Canada is an associated country, so a cross-Canada–EU consortium applies on near-EU terms.
explainer: This is the big one. Canada signed on to Horizon Europe Pillar II, so our consortium can draw a multi-million-euro grant that most non-EU countries can't. Funds our full scale-up program with EU partners.

name: EUREKA / Eurostars
description: International SME-led research and development, and Canada is an eligible country. The Canadian share is paid through NRC IRAP.
explainer: Easiest new door to open today — smaller, faster, for the de-risking R&D with a European partner. Canadian funding comes from our own NRC IRAP agency.

name: EU Innovation Fund (ETS)
description: Funded by EU carbon-allowance revenue. Europe's biggest clean-tech money, built on CCS and net-zero technology — a direct fit for methane.
explainer: Very large amounts, but the project must physically sit in the EU or EEA. Best reached through a European subsidiary or partner hosting the demonstration site.

name: EIC Accelerator
description: Europe's deep-tech scale-up instrument: grant plus direct equity for breakthrough startups. Sits outside Canada's association.
explainer: A real prize but only if we form (relocate to) an EU entity first — Canada's agreement doesn't cover this pillar. Keep for a future EU arm.

name: LIFE — Clean Energy Transition
description: EU programme for coordination and support on the clean-energy transition — market uptake, investor readiness, policy support.
explainer: Funds the 'how to commercialize' work more than the hardware. A European partner leads; we can contribute a work-package on methane-to-energy uptake.

name: EU Global Gateway
description: The EU's strategy to mobilise up to €300B+ for clean, secure infrastructure in partner countries — a co-investment lever rather than a grant.
explainer: Direction is EU investing outward via EIB and development banks. Useful for capital-formation alongside the grants, not a direct grant for us.

name: EU Methane Reduction Support
description: EU financial support announced at COP28 to cut methane — and the 2027 Methane Regulation makes importers verify gas intensity, a demand-side tailwind.
explainer: Two parts: a funding pool for methane abatement, plus a rule that makes verified low-methane gas worth more. Our measure-and-reduce model is a compliance tool.
